about: One entry per portal page this project edits. `path` is the page under your www/ tree; `base` (when present) is the page the diff is computed from, for pages that are a second copy of an existing page. `sha256_original` is the page as served by Square Enix; `sha256_patched` is the result. `newlines: lf` means the original's CRLF line endings are converted to LF before the diff is applied. The `dev` block describes the maintainer's own tree and is only read by --selftest and --rebuild; `dev.repair` names mechanical damage found in that tree's copy (an editor accident, not an edit) which the diff deliberately does not carry.

patches.description: Main menu: $gmTest 0 -> 1 shows SE's own GM Call button, and three guards ($bnAny, $BANNERSIZE[$i]>0) stop a platform with no banner rows from rendering (Array Error) in the pickup box and in banner image URLs.
Games submenu: our games list, one menu entry per content id this server can grant (adds the titles SE's final page no longer listed), on SE's own $_USER_LANG.
patches.original_source: .se-orig sibling in the development tree, md5 065157605d09c4f48531c5c391a6e6b8, 16940 bytes

patches.description: FINAL FANTASY XI top page: $bgs 3 -> 1 (the tree holds bgd00 and bgd01 only, so bgd02 would 404 into the Viewer's error background) and SE's own commented-out Test Server Play block (sh_testplay) restored, gated on $_PLATFORM=='WIN' alone.

FRONT MISSION ONLINE top page: SE's <!bgsound> and <!systembg> tags un-commented (they shipped as comments, so neither ever played or showed) and the 640x480 scrim lightened from #000000ff to #000000a6 so the system background shows through.

dev.repair_note: a search-and-replace turned every = in SE's comment banners and several live tags into -; the patch keeps SE's bytes

patches.description: Tetra Master top page translated to English (SE never served an English one): title, button captions and hint text, the alert shown while another game runs, a 14 px caption style so the English fits the button art, and Back pointed at the main menu.
patches.original_source: SE's Japanese page as cached by a PS2 Viewer, md5 d4a61334882a5d5c3679b93d1b4efa48, 10939 bytes

dev.repair_note: SE's Shift-JIS comment bytes were rewritten as U+FFFD by an editor; the patch keeps SE's bytes

Written as a second copy under _eras/panel/, which the server serves to panel-era clients.
